text: ぜんぜん　めずらしい　ポケモン　なんて　いねえし！

structure.jp: めずらしい　ポケモン　なんて

patterns.name: 〜なんて
patterns.explanation: なんて after a thing points at it with scorn or disappointment, like 'anything like' or 'such a thing as'. ポケモン　なんて = 'Pokémon, of all things'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ない makes a verb negative; rough male speech turns ない into ねえ. いねえ is いない = 'there aren't any'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し at the end gives a reason for a complaint and hints there is more to grumble about. いねえし = 'there aren't any, for one thing'.
